control_reuse: 8192 adaptive k1 reuses exact main trace/seed/repetition observations; no duplicate measurement
warmup: one separate process at seed 7 per unique condition/variant before measurements; does not warm the next process heap/cache
paired: same trace and repeat; summarize time noise within each of 5 seeds before across-seed comparison; 15 timings are not 15 inputs
trace_source: prefer TSV bytes in experiments/eas/results/full/raw_data.tar.gz; regenerate with existing generator and verify SHA256/bytes; generate only missing conditions

quality.maximum: all 2^n transaction subsets, n<=18, only exhaustive and random quality cases; no large-input optimum claim
quality.minimize: first witness of each strict direction: repeatedly delete transactions or identify keys while preserving exact arity 2 and inequality; preserve ID order; local minimality only

sensitivity.model: C/(measured_batch_seconds+n*c); c hypothetical uniform per attempted transaction, no retries

verification: C++ independent all-pairs oracle, direct disjointness/maximality, full actual-Aria snapshot/private-write/serial full-state validation outside timing; EAS exact arrays grouped by policy AND k
scope: single-node CPU in-memory point complete RMW; no Issue #4, port, retry engine, merge or force push
